description: Commercial biomechanics report with strict metric semantics. Every metric carries kind, validity, confidence, residual, units, and value. Personal/practice/strategy sections are optional engines: implemented=true only when prior/session/context args actually compute them.

truth.description: Citeable wrist / timing / trajectory P0 metrics (measured or derived).

inference.description: Proxy and inferred high-order metrics. Never claim measured / launch-monitor truth.

personal_baseline.implemented: bool — true only when prior/personal_score provided
personal_baseline.description: Signed errors vs personal biomech prior (preferred) or tour ideal fallback. See personal_biomech/schemas/personal-baseline-v1.json.

practice_loop.description: Next-shot correction features for practice loop. See personal_biomech/schemas/practice-loop-v1.json.

strategy.description: Round strategy precursor features (explicitly not strokes gained). See personal_biomech/schemas/strategy-v1.json.

swing_report_compatibility: CommercialSwingReport is an export projection; SwingReport fields and pipeline return type are unchanged.
